preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each event type t is either 1 (boss assignment), 2 (document packet), or 3 (query).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '1' and len(line.split()) == 3 for x, y in [(line.split()[1], line.split()[2])])
preconditions.description: For type 1 events, x and y are valid employee numbers (1 ≤ x, y ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2' and len(line.split()) == 2 for x in [line.split()[1]])
preconditions.description: For type 2 events, x is a valid employee number (1 ≤ x ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(i) <= packet_count for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '3' and len(line.split()) == 3 for x, i in [(line.split()[1], line.split()[2])])
preconditions.description: For type 3 events, x is a valid employee number (1 ≤ x ≤ n) and i is a valid packet number (1 ≤ i ≤ packet_count, where packet_count is the number of packets given so far).
The first line contains integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 10^5), representing the number of employees and events, respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 if line.split()[0] == '1' else len(line.split()) == 2 if line.split()[0] == '2' else len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each event line has the correct number of arguments: 3 for type 1 and 3, 2 for type 2.
The input contains at least one query of type 3.
The company's boss hierarchy never contains cycles (guaranteed by the problem statement).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line for a type 3 query is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line == 'YES') == (x in get_signers(x, i, events) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '3' for x, i in [(line.split()[1], line.split()[2])] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if (x, i) == (line.split()[1], line.split()[2]))
postconditions.description: For each type 3 query (x, i), the output is 'YES' if and only if employee x signed the i-th document packet. The i-th packet is the one given on the i-th type 2 event in chronological order.
